description: This PHP class defines a plugin component for the Revive Adserver, specifically handling impression logging for openX delivery logs. It includes methods for retrieving dependency information, bucket table details, and statistics migration mappings.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLog_OxLogImpression_LogImpression
classes.description: A plugin class for handling impression logging in openX delivery logs within the Revive Adserver.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns the dependencies for this impression log plugin.

methods.name: getBucketName
methods.description: Returns the name of the bucket table used for impression data.

methods.name: getBucketTableColumns
methods.description: Returns the columns and their types for the bucket table.

methods.name: getStatisticsName
methods.description: Returns the name of the statistics table for aggregated data.

methods.name: getStatisticsMigration
methods.description: Provides the mapping for migrating bucket data into statistics.
